title: Concept: File access built from input (python) — review required
description: In python, opens*([^)]*+ assembles a filesystem path from parts. Traversal payloads (..%2f, absolute paths, symlink races) redirect the operation outside its directory. The python-specific remedy is confinement via os.path.realpath plus prefix check.
applicability: python codebases opening files with assembled paths; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Arbitrary file read or write when untrusted input reaches the path; HIGH severity because traversal payloads are trivial and impact is filesystem-wide.
